properties.name: embabel.agent.decision.enabled
properties.description: Enable experimental typed decision models. With no declarations, registers the implicit jev model.

properties.name: embabel.agent.decision.default-timeout
properties.description: Default timeout shared by every configured decision model.

properties.name: embabel.agent.decision.record-mode
properties.description: Record mode shared by every configured decision model: none, metadata, or full.

properties.name: embabel.agent.decision.full-record-max-bytes
properties.description: Maximum bytes retained by full records.

properties.name: embabel.agent.decision.record-allowlist
properties.description: Explicit fields allowed in full records.

properties.name: embabel.agent.decision.mapper-bean-name
properties.description: Exact EmbabelObjectMapperHolder bean name shared by configured models.

properties.name: embabel.agent.decision.models
properties.description: Named model declarations. Each lowercase alphanumeric or hyphenated map key, for example proposition-revision, is both the Spring bean and registry name; dots and underscores are unsupported. Values select provider typesafe, prompted, or none and its JavaBean provider block. The TypeSafe model is the backend requested model, distinct from the registry name. A nonempty map replaces the implicit jev declaration, which requests jev-latest.
